posts.text: Summary of 2027Q1 Conference Call. Jubilant Ingrevia Limited reported a strong start to FY27, achieving a 15-quarter high in revenue and significant growth across all business segments despite geopolitical uncertainties in the Middle East. Financial Performance Highlights Revenue: Reached ₹1,300 crore, representing a 25% year-on-year (YoY) increase. EBITDA: Grew by 36% YoY to ₹209 crore, with margins benefiting from improved pricing and a richer product mix. Profit After Tax (PAT): Increased by 41% YoY to ₹106 crore.
